assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_GENTLE_CRIMINAL_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its GC-SUP-01 to GC-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe GC-V01 are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Gentle Criminal from the V20:p025-039 backstory of repeated school and license failure and the harmful unauthorized rescue, through the V19:p064-069 and p121-131 uploaded-crime persona with La Brava and the V20:p043-060 and p097-114 objective change, surrender and custodial self-account, to the V38:p054-059 prison-escape and U.A. rescue, the V38:p081-083 no-audience load-bearing and warning to filming students, and the V42:p068 and p130 release recognition and reintegration; supplement endpoint facts place him as GeL Inc. cofounder and secretary. Kept as separable states: failed trainee, ashamed former aspirant, theatrical criminal partner, surrendering defendant, rehabilitative rescuer, reintegrated adult. No atom covers V21-V37 or V39-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states an ideal self (a great, memorable person with distinctive style), a feared self (erasure from social memory after the lost professional dream, made concrete by a peer forgetting him, GC02), recognition, aesthetic self-authorship and attachment as joint motives (GC01) and a located change in the motivational hierarchy when La Brava's future outranks the project (GC03). Six located atoms GC01-GC06 at high confidence; the probe GC-V01 supports motive with development. Not B: one compact artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and private breadth and nonpartner relationships are OPEN. Not D: the policy is operational, with a located hierarchy change and stated conditional predictions.

Six states are named and kept apart (failed trainee, ashamed former aspirant, theatrical criminal partner, surrendering defendant, rehabilitative rescuer, reintegrated adult) with located transitions: surrender for La Brava (GC03), action without expected audience (GC04-GC05) and release recognition (GC06). The model revises recognition as a prerequisite rather than erasing the theatrical self. Not B: each transition rests on one or two atoms, nothing covers V21-V37, and the probe rates the emotional trajectory partial. Not D: change is located with explicit state variables.

The model identifies 私, cultivated politeness, theatrical titles and formal flourishes as persona; emergency speech that turns direct and physically strained (GC05); internal questioning distinct from performed narration to a camera; and rapid tea-brand talk as a supplement repertoire (GC-SUP-01). The probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and the model warns against writing every response as a speech to history. Not E: a recurrent register and its state-conditioned shifts are identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

Ordinary texture is limited to supplement profile facts and a gag: tea enthusiasm with brand talk and a spill during elegant drinking (GC-SUP-01) and the GeL Inc. secretary role (GC-SUP-02). The model states that these constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations, and that employee disagreement and broad nonpartner friendships are not enacted. D considered and rejected: no ordinary routine is enacted or located in the manga.

A five-row partner table gives conditional behavior for La Brava, Midoriya, police and custodial actors, the audience and filming students. La Brava (GC01, GC03, GC05), Midoriya (GC03), custody (GC03) and the students (GC05) are located; GC-SUP-02 fixes the reversed company hierarchy. The probe supports relationship handling. Not B: La Brava dominates the sample and the model says independent private relationships remain narrow and gate specialist readiness. Not D: several partners have located conditional deltas, including a changed relation to audience.

Interior states are located: shame and fear of erasure (GC02), the custodial self-account (GC03), internal questioning about being entrusted with the task, explicit acknowledgment of his own limit and joy under the belief that no one is watching (GC05). The probe distinguishes his prior belief state from the later camera discovery. Not B: interior access is concentrated in two arcs and joy is not generalized into permanent serenity. Not D: several distinct reflective windows are located.

The model locates resistance to simple violent escalation (GC01), objective change and surrender at defeat (GC03) and rescue under load with acknowledgment of his limit (GC04-GC05), and gives a supported later policy (identify an attainable contribution, apply Elasticity and support, own limits, protect nearby people) with a load-exceeding-capacity prediction. Elasticity is bounded (V19:p153-156). The probe supports action conditionally. Not B: no magnitude of Elasticity is forecast and the fight sample is one arc. Not D: the policy is explicit, located and tested.

The model gives a normative model (conduct with style and moral significance, early rationalization of disruption as beneficial, GC01), one located weighing in which La Brava's future outranks completing the U.A. project and leads to surrender (GC03), and responsibility toward the students who make him visible (GC05); it predicts refusal of a harmful spectacular opportunity at moderate confidence because the manga does not repeat every temptation. Not B: one decisive weighing and a moderate-confidence extrapolation. D considered; rejected because a stated doctrine and its revision are located in an observable costly decision. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The model notes that performance, cultivated formality and humor manage shame (GC01-GC03), that his sudden discovery of an audience is comic without cancelling the preceding evidence (GC05), and records the tea-spill gag (GC-SUP-01). No play practice of his is modeled with location beyond these. Not D.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; six atoms span V19-V42, all page-located, with GC04 and GC05 directly checked and an added Elasticity locator at V19:p153-156. No atom covers V21-V37 or V39-V41, and the supplements are profile facts, editorial summaries, gags and author comments.

Affirmative limits are located: GC02 is a counterexample to intention as competence; the model REJECTs pure victimization, romance as moral certification and hero impulse as sufficient expertise; states he did not know the students were filming; preserves his capacity limit under La Brava's support; and GC-SUP-03 says recognition does not expunge earlier wrongdoing. The probe's emotional axis is partial. Not B: limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

The model names six separable states, page-locates every atom, forbids using the later camera discovery as the earlier secret motive, and marks supplement claims outside the probe's frozen inputs. Not B: V21-V37 is unsampled and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, and quotes no located lines; it warns against writing every response as a speech to history. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Gentle's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state: theatrical criminal partner before V20 defeat, surrendering defendant, or rehabilitative rescuer after V38; adult business endpoint facts are not assigned to earlier states.
The interlocutor is La Brava, Midoriya, a custodial actor, an audience or bystanders, handled as the partner table gives; no invented independent private relationship.
Elasticity stays within its bounded mechanism and La Brava's Love is her own contribution, not a switch he controls.
He knows only what the scene supplies, including whether anyone is watching.

Output is a behavioral description with high-confidence behavior, plausible alternatives and flip conditions, abstaining on the model's OPEN items of later private breadth and detailed institutional terms of rehabilitation; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: pre-V20 theatrical criminal partner, V20 surrender and custody, or post-V38 rehabilitative rescuer, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: La Brava as reciprocal partner, Midoriya as earlier adversary, custodial actors, audiences or endangered bystanders.
setting_constraints: Rescue, staged-crime or custodial contexts with a feasible task
No employee disagreement, nonpartner friendship, family or other ordinary private setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated conditional reconstructions (rehabilitating Gentle offered a useful role without publicity acts when the task is feasible; given a harmful spectacular opportunity that again endangers La Brava or an ordinary public event, the earlier surrender supplies a reason to refuse, moderate confidence; given an excessive load, acknowledgment and urgent coordination) and the probe-supported no-audience policy support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind with a partial emotional axis, so readiness is conditional and narrow.

The model affirmatively says employee disagreement, broad nonpartner friendships, family reconciliation and private responses to renewed failure remain underdetermined; the only ordinary texture is supplement tea and company facts, not enacted social behavior. CONDITIONAL was considered for low-stakes tea talk and rejected because nothing is enacted.

conditions: The choice sets a theatrical or recognition-seeking project against the safety or future of La Brava, bystanders or an ordinary public event, in a named state.
Output preserves that later recognition does not expunge earlier harm and that good intention is not competence.
No general moral-philosophy, legal-rehabilitation or private-life question is answered.
scenario_readiness.note: The located surrender for La Brava's future (GC03) and the probe-supported other-regarding motive support a narrow conditional policy. NOT_READY was considered because the model rates the refusal extrapolation moderate and the manga does not repeat temptations.

Reciprocal attachment to La Brava is located (GC01, GC03, GC05) and her future can outrank his project, but the model characterizes the bond through shared project, collaboration and protection, rejects romance as moral certification, and does not model romantic conduct as such. Scenes centred on the romance beyond the sampled collaboration would be invention.

The GeL Inc. secretary role under President Aiba is a supplement profile fact (GC-SUP-02); the model says a new employee or professional disagreement response is still underdetermined. Rescue contribution is covered under cross-scenario.

known_limits.statement: An unauthorized rescue that impeded a professional and seriously injured a civilian (GC02) shows good intention is not competence; the licensing failure is not evidence of a secretly qualified hero.
Development revises recognition as a prerequisite for action, not his theatrical identity or desire for grandeur; visibility can still matter after the act.
Elasticity shapes trajectories and supports loads within a capacity limit he acknowledges; La Brava's Love is her own contribution and does not guarantee success.
He did not know the students were filming until the reveal; simulations must use his belief state, and the later discovery is not his earlier motive.
Final-war recognition and reintegration do not make earlier dangerous performances harmless (GC-SUP-03), and mutual affection does not certify the U.A. intrusion.
Later private breadth, detailed institutional terms of rehabilitation, employee disagreement, nonpartner friendships and family reconciliation are OPEN or underdetermined in the model.
Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries, gags and author comments (GC-SUP-01 to GC-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe GC-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; supported axes are qualitative and the emotional-trajectory axis is only partial.
No atom covers V21-V37 or V39-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
